introduction_markdown:
Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board, General Certificate of Education Examination, ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2019. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2, subject code 0575. Time allowed: two and a half hours.

Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three.

Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory to all candidates, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions; if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions).

All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take $g$ as $10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.

The marks scored by $80$ students in an examination are distributed as follows:

| Marks ($x$) | 0-9 | 10-19 | 20-29 | 30-39 | 40-49 | 50-59 | 60-69 | 70-79 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of students ($f$) | 1 | 4 | 11 | 17 | 28 | 12 | 4 | 3 |
incertitudes: Section B/C : la consigne imprimee (reponse a deux questions de la Section B OU de la Section C, jamais un melange des trois) n'est pas exprimable par les regles de choix (« parmi 2 sur 3 » par section) ; elle est recopiee en entier dans l'introduction. Chaque question de B et C vaut 17 points imprimes (egalite annoncee par le sujet).

Q12 : points imprimes (i)(a) 5, (b) 3, (c) 4, (ii) 5 = 17, conformes. Effectifs relus : 1 + 4 + 11 + 17 + 28 + 12 + 4 + 3 = 80, conforme. La courbe des frequences cumulees (a) est a tracer par le candidat : decrite dans le corrige (points, echelle) ; mediane et ecart semi-interquartile calcules par interpolation lineaire (lecture graphique attendue : environ 42, 8,6).
Q12 : l'en-tete de la Section C est imprime « IF THIS SECTION IS CHOOSEN, THEN ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS » (faute d'impression, recopie corrigee en « chosen »).

questions.enonce_markdown: (i) (a) Draw a cumulative frequency graph of the distribution. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The classes are whole marks $0$-$9$, $10$-$19$, ... so the class boundaries are $-0.5,\ 9.5,\ 19.5,\dots,79.5$. Plot each cumulative frequency against the **upper class boundary**.

| Upper boundary | $9.5$ | $19.5$ | $29.5$ | $39.5$ | $49.5$ | $59.5$ | $69.5$ | $79.5$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cumulative frequency | $1$ | $5$ | $16$ | $33$ | $61$ | $73$ | $77$ | $80$ |

(For instance $1+4=5$, $5+11=16$, $16+17=33$, $33+28=61$, $61+12=73$, $73+4=77$, $77+3=80$.)

**Drawing:** choose a scale such as $2$ cm per $10$ marks on the horizontal axis ($0$ to $80$) and $2$ cm per $10$ students on the vertical axis ($0$ to $80$). Plot the points $(-0.5,0)$ (start), $(9.5,1)$, $(19.5,5)$, $(29.5,16)$, $(39.5,33)$, $(49.5,61)$, $(59.5,73)$, $(69.5,77)$, $(79.5,80)$ and join them with a smooth S-shaped curve (the ogive). Label the axes "Marks" and "Cumulative frequency".

questions.enonce_markdown:
From your graph, estimate

(b) the median, *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
There are $80$ students, so the median corresponds to the $\dfrac{80}{2}=40$th value. Draw a horizontal line from $40$ on the cumulative frequency axis to the curve, then read down to the $x$-axis.

The value $40$ lies in the class with boundaries $39.5$ to $49.5$ (cumulative frequency goes from $33$ to $61$). Linear interpolation (the straight segment of the graph):

$$
\text{median}=39.5+\frac{40-33}{28}\times10=39.5+2.5=42
$$

**The median is about $42$ marks.**

The lower quartile is at $\dfrac{80}{4}=20$ and the upper quartile at $\dfrac{3\times80}{4}=60$.

- $Q_1$: the value $20$ is in the class $29.5$ to $39.5$ (cumulative frequency from $16$ to $33$): $Q_1=29.5+\dfrac{20-16}{17}\times10\approx29.5+2.35=31.85$.
- $Q_3$: the value $60$ is in the class $39.5$ to $49.5$ (from $33$ to $61$): $Q_3=39.5+\dfrac{60-33}{28}\times10\approx39.5+9.64=49.14$.

$$
\text{Semi-interquartile range}=\frac{Q_3-Q_1}{2}=\frac{49.14-31.85}{2}\approx8.6
$$

**The semi-interquartile range is about $8.6$ marks** (readings from a careful graph: $Q_1\approx32$, $Q_3\approx49$, giving about $8.5$).
